notes.source: Sports Mole, Last Word on Sports team news (Sep 2026)
notes.text: Newcastle are missing three regulars until after the international break -- Joelinton (thigh), Dan Burn (ankle), William Osula (ankle) -- plus a fitness doubt on Amar Dedic (hamstring). Leeds are close to full strength: only Joe Rodon out with no new concerns, and Ilia Gruev could return from his own knee issue. A meaningfully healthier Leeds side than the market gap between them suggests.
